en:
There was something the culprit could
have used to slide the body! The <CLT=cltSTRONG>signboard<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
The signboard!?

You put Miu's body on top and use
it as a kind of sled.

You *could* use it to slide the body, but the
signboard we used as a bridge was the only one.

The culprit couldn't have used that
signboard as a sled.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki is right, it couldn't have been
that exact signboard. However...

<CLT=cltMIND><CLT=cltSTRONG>He<CLT=cltMIND> knows exactly how
it was done.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's why I need to bait him out
with this <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltMIND>!
...What if there was <CLT=cltSTRONG>another<CLT=cltNORMAL> signboard?
Huh? Another one?

Do you remember the first time I
went to get the signboard?

There were actually <CLT=cltSTRONG>two<CLT=cltNORMAL> there.
But I only brought one...

The culprit must have used the
other one as a sled.

But then why did Miu say 
there was <CLT=cltSTRONG>only one<CLT=cltNORMAL> signboard?

Uh... To mislead us; she was planning
a crime, after all...
Puhu... Puhuhuhuhu...!

Ah-hahahaha! Oh my god! That lie was 
sooo cringy! Stop, my stomach hurts!

Wooow! Shuichi is lying on purpose! Are you
trying to spice up the class trial, too?
Nyeh!? What Shuichi just said was a lie!?

Kokichi...I was the only one who went and
got the signboard. Only I saw them.
So why do you think I'm lying?

Because I know.
I know the culprit...and the whole trick.
Wh-What!?

Then tell us! We can put an end to this
class trial right now!

Nee-heehee... I couuuld tell you, but I 
think we should save the best for last.

Even if I told you, would you guys really
believe a liar like me?

I could be lying about knowing who the
culprit is, for all you know.
Wh-What...?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's no lie.
He really does know everything.

<CLT=cltMIND>If he didn't, he wouldn't
be able to discern any lies at all.

<CLT=cltMIND>What's his goal, here? Why
is he leading us like this...?

This doesn't mean *all* of Shuichi's
deductions are lies, y'know.

You're right about the culprit putting Miu 
on a sled and sliding her down the roof...

But instead of a sled, they used <CLT=cltSTRONG>that thing<CLT=cltNORMAL>
from the storage room on the roof.
You mean the <CLT=cltSTRONG>lattice<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

When I first looked in the storage room on
the roof, I saw the lattice there...

No, wait! There was something that could
have been used to help slide Miu's body!

Do you remember the <CLT=cltSTRONG>lattice<CLT=cltNORMAL>
that was found by Miu's avatar?

The culprit laid her on top of that,
then used it as a sled on the roof.

I did notice the lattice in the storage
room when I first looked...

...but during the investigation, I saw
that it was gone.

The lattice that was found next to the chapel
is the one that disappeared from the roof?

Then that's it! The culprit used the lattice
as a sled!
Ding ding ding! That's correct!

The impact made all of her belongings scatter,
including the hammer and cell phone...

Just like that hedgehog who loses all his
rings whenever he crashes into stuff...

I...I hate that guy and his worldwide fame and
his stupid games and...I! Hate! That! Hedgehog!

Daddy...I'm glad you're feeling motivated
again, but you shouldn't be so hateful.
You...gotta be an example to our new family.

Yeah, Father. Or should I start calling
you "Grandfather" now?

Now that we know how the body slid down,
we're just one step away from the culprit.

Well, Shuichi?
Do you know who the <CLT=cltSTRONG>culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL> is?
<CLT=cltMIND>The culprit...

Y-Yeah... In the end, we'll still need
to guess the culprit, huh?

But...Gonta can't believe one of us
killed Miu.

However, since we know she was killed on the
roof, we can narrow down the list of suspects.

Meaning, the culprit must be <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone who
was investigating the mansion<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Aside from Miu, the people at the chapel could
not go through the wall or cross the river.

So that means...the suspects are
Kaito, Tsumugi, Shuichi, and Gonta...

That's real sneaky, leaving yourself off the
list!
Nee-heehee... Oh, you got me.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right, five suspects...
Me, Tsumugi, Gonta, Kokichi and Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>We don't know enough to name the
culprit yet, but one of them is suspicious...

<CLT=cltMIND>When we were talking about the
rooftop, they clearly lied...

<CLT=cltMIND>But what reason would
they have to lie?

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll need to press them for information
before making any judgments.

...Kaito...did you lie about
something on the roof?

What are you talking about!?
I wouldn't lie!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

...Gonta, did you lie about
something on the roof?

What? Gonta doesn't really understand
this Virtual World stuff...

But there's no way Gonta would ever
kill Miu! Believe that!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

...Tsumugi, did you lie about
something on the roof?

Umm... I didn't really have any 
reason to lie about the roof...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Oh, man...so many suspects to choose from.
Is this giving you some trouble, detective?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

No! If we look at the direction of the movement,
it must be someone who went to the roof!
I never went up there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Who is the liar?
Kokichi, there's something I need to know.
Hm? What do you need to know?
Why did you lie just now?

Which lie are you talking about, Shuichi? 
I lie a lot, so you'll need to jog my memory.
Fine. I'll expose <CLT=cltSTRONG>your lie<CLT=cltNORMAL> right now...

Also, I never went to the roof, not even
for the meeting.
It all began when Miu showed us the map.

That's probably what happened. 
The culprit killed her on the locked roof.
It was that testimony that bothered me.
